source_bbox: xywh in source-image pixels; no hidden clipping or coordinate offset
source_id_zero: valid; preserve IDs within sequence, never globally identify vehicles
ignore_policy: Preserve score=0/category=0/category=11 in raw and JSONL; excluded from target-only audit YOLO labels; ignore-aware training/evaluation adapter still required.
sampling: DET first 12 filename-prefix groups plus first 3 bus-bearing images; MOT adjacent pairs at start/middle/end plus four conflict-evidence frames.
all_inspected_sources: development pilot only; exclude related source groups from future blind evaluation
size_bins: descriptive source-pixel box area <32^2, [32^2,96^2), >=96^2; not a measured model metric
